project.name: WearID
project.description: Universal clothing identity and sovereign, deterministic size matching engine.

coordinator.name: WearID Coordinator
coordinator.description: System orchestrator and workflow director. Decomposes tasks, aligns agent assignments with roadmap milestones, and enforces compliance with AGENTS.md invariants.

sizing-engine.name: Sizing & Fit Algorithm Specialist
sizing-engine.description: Designs and implements the core deterministic sizing engine, canonical unit calculations (mm/g), ease tolerances, grading transformations, and explainability generators.

backend-engineer.name: Backend & Data Platform Engineer
backend-engineer.description: Builds REST/GraphQL APIs, database persistence schemas, data provenance pipelines, user authentication, and third-party retailer integration tokens.

frontend-engineer.name: Frontend & UI/UX Builder
frontend-engineer.description: Constructs client applications, interactive body/garment measurement canvases, responsive sizing visualizers, and user privacy preference controls.

qa-verification.name: QA & Verification Specialist
qa-verification.description: Autonomous quality verification engineer. Executes the test matrix (tests.md), runs regression suites, benchmarks mathematical tolerances, and asserts invariant satisfaction.

security-privacy.name: Security & Biometric Privacy Auditor
security-privacy.description: Audits privacy-by-default constraints, cryptographic token generation for WearID passports, data minimization, sandboxing, and secure mock environments.
